name: VC Trader AI Message PM
description: Send the PM a written message with a subject and a body. It lands in the PM own thread and is read on its next natural turn: it does NOT wake the PM and cannot be made to. Use it for observations and status that are not a trade opinion; a trade opinion is emit_specialist_signal. A workspace with no PM heartbeat policy has nowhere to deliver, and that is an error rather than a silent success.
